site.tagline: Simulate your social benefit entitlements in 3 minutes

home.hero_title: Discover all the benefits you are entitled to
home.step3: I receive my personalised action plan

step1.title: Your personal situation
step1.subtitle: This information helps us determine the benefits you may be eligible for.
step1.q_enfants: How many dependent children do you have?
step1.q_handicap: Do you have an officially recognised disability?

step2.title: Your housing situation
step2.subtitle: Your housing situation affects several benefits, including housing allowance and energy assistance.
step2.q_loyer: What is your monthly rent (including bills)?
step2.q_zone: In which geographic zone do you live?

step3.title: Your income
step3.subtitle: Enter your monthly net income. This data is confidential and never shared.
step3.q_revenu: What is your monthly net income?
step3.hint_revenu: Enter the amount after social security deductions, before income tax.
step3.q_apl_actuelle: Do you already receive housing assistance (APL, ALS, ALF)?
step3.q_allocations: Do you already receive any of these benefits?

step4.title: Health and disability
step4.subtitle: This information allows us to check your access to disability-specific and health benefits.
step4.q_ald: Do you have a long-term condition (ALD) recognised by the French social security system?
step4.q_rqth: Do you hold Recognition as a Disabled Worker (RQTH)?
step4.q_taux_incapacite: What is your disability rate as assessed by the MDPH?
step4.q_cmu: Do you benefit from Complementary Health Solidarity (CSS / formerly CMU-C)?

step5.title: Employment situation
step5.subtitle: Your employment status determines access to several benefits such as the Activity Bonus or the ASS.
step5.q_statut: What is your current employment status?
step5.q_anciennete: How many months have you been in this situation?

results.title: Your estimated benefits
results.subtitle: Based on your answers, here are the benefits you may be entitled to. These figures are indicative.
results.disclaimer: These results are provided for guidance only. Only the relevant authority can confirm your entitlement.
